Episodes.Actors: George Blagden, Alexander Vlahos, Tygh Runyan
Episodes.Plot: Louis welcomes a defeated royal relative to the palace, but with unforeseen personal consequences.

Episodes.Title: Question of Trust
Episodes.Actors: George Blagden, Alexander Vlahos, Tygh Runyan
Episodes.Plot: Little can be taken at face value as Louis negotiates with Leopold over Spain, the Bastille governor has a sorry tale for Philippe and Sophie surprises Marchal.

Episodes.Writer: Simon Mirren, David Wolstencroft, Martha Hillier
Episodes.Actors: George Blagden, Alexander Vlahos, Tygh Runyan
Episodes.Plot: A betrayal by one of the women closest to the king has unforeseen consequences, while a graphic revelation results in a fall from grace for another.

Episodes.Title: Crime and Punishment
Episodes.Writer: Simon Mirren, David Wolstencroft, Steve Bailie
Episodes.Actors: George Blagden, Alexander Vlahos, Tygh Runyan
Episodes.Plot: Seeking retribution, Louis lashes out at the Parisian rebels though Philippe urges a more reasoned response.

Episodes.Title: The After-Life
Episodes.Writer: Simon Mirren, David Wolstencroft, Andrew Bampfield
Episodes.Actors: George Blagden, Alexander Vlahos, Tygh Runyan
Episodes.Plot: Can Louis' longed-for loving touch help the ailing queen? An engraved blade holds a clue to who Philippe has antagonised.

Episodes.Title: The Wheel of Fortune
Episodes.Writer: Simon Mirren, David Wolstencroft, Andrew Bampfield
Episodes.Actors: George Blagden, Alexander Vlahos, Tygh Runyan
Episodes.Plot: Louis hopes diplomacy will hide his duplicity as he works to undermine Leopold while winning over severe cardinal Leto.

Episodes.Title: The Book of Revelations
Episodes.Writer: Simon Mirren, David Wolstencroft, Tim Loane
Episodes.Actors: George Blagden, Alexander Vlahos, Tygh Runyan
Episodes.Plot: Has Louis finally learnt the identity of the man in the iron mask? Cardinal Leto is still determined to use his knowledge against the king.

Episodes.Title: Men and Gods
Episodes.Writer: Simon Mirren, David Wolstencroft, Steve Bailie
Episodes.Actors: George Blagden, Yohann Chopin, Alexander Vlahos
Episodes.Plot: Suffering an identity crisis, Louis gets moody, unable to reveal the reason. Jeanne's protest pamphlets in Paris bring reprisals led by Marchal.

Episodes.Title: The Powder Keg
Episodes.Writer: Simon Mirren, David Wolstencroft, Tim Loane
Episodes.Actors: George Blagden, Alexander Vlahos, Tygh Runyan
Episodes.Plot: His resolve reinforced, Louis is dismissive of the pain his plans will cause others, be they Philippe or Protestants of all classes. Cardinal Leto is confident of making the king marry Isabella of Portugal.

Episodes.Title: The Legacy
Episodes.Writer: Simon Mirren, David Wolstencroft, Tim Loane
Episodes.Actors: George Blagden, Alexander Vlahos, Tygh Runyan
Episodes.Plot: Looking to the future, King Louis XIV seeks to reconnect with his people, and reconcile his family.
